name: de.choreo-planer/cheer-choreo-tool
title: Choreo Planer MCP Server
description: Create and manage cheerleading choreographies as structured data: clubs, teams, seasons, members, choreos, hits, lineups and positions.

tools.name: choreo-service
tools.description: Create, read, update and delete choreographies, their hits, lineups and positions, and export countsheets.

tools.name: team-service
tools.description: Manage teams and their season assignments.

tools.name: position-service
tools.description: Manage member positions within a lineup for each count.

tools.name: lineup-service
tools.description: Manage lineups that group member positions for a choreography.

tools.name: season-service
tools.description: Manage seasons used to scope teams and choreographies.

tools.name: season-team-service
tools.description: Manage assignments between seasons and teams.
